display.longDescription: 在 Ubuntu 实例里安装 Microsoft 官方 arm64 VS Code，并通过 Kite 内嵌 X11 桌面能力打开。

steps.cmd:
install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings
gpg --dearmor < "$install_root/microsoft.asc" > /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg
chmod 0644 /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg
printf 'Types: deb
URIs: https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code
Suites: stable
Components: main
Architectures: arm64
Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg
' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.sources

base.name: VS Code
base.description: 启动 VS Code 桌面版

recipe.cmd:
set -e
if ! command -v code >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'VS Code 还没有安装完整，请先点获取或重新获取。'; exit 127; fi
mkdir -p /workspace/.kf/cache/vscode-x11/extensions /workspace/.kf/runtime/vscode-x11/user-data
proxy="${KITE_DESKTOP_PROXY:-/workspace/.kf/bin/kite-open-desktop}"
if [ ! -x "$proxy" ]; then echo 'Kite X11 桌面代理不可用，请重新打开实例。'; exit 127; fi
"$proxy" "ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU=1 LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 GTK_USE_PORTAL=0 code --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --disable-dev-shm-usage --ozone-platform=x11 --user-data-dir=/workspace/.kf/runtime/vscode-x11/user-data --extensions-dir=/workspace/.kf/cache/vscode-x11/extensions /workspace"
